format: GF Trinity encrypted UTF-16 message DAT

messages.displayText:
Get your Lumiose Galettes here!
Loved by man and ’mon alike! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Make sure you’re ready for the
Pokémon in the back alleys! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You know, a good ambiance really
affects the flavor of your meal! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

It’s a big shock when an opponent
sends out a big Pokémon in battle!

I’ll get a bunch of Mega Shards
and trade them for Mega Stones!

The battle zones that activate at night are scary!
I’ll stick to battle courts during the day, thank you.

When you fall in love with someone, you fall in
love with their voice, the sound of their footsteps,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
even the sounds they make when they eat!
My absolute favorite brand is Valerie Kawaguchi!

I need a new place, but it’s gotta
be big enough for my Pokémon...

I heard there’s a Poké Ball that never fails to catch
Pokémon. It’s called a Master Ball!

Everyone keeps talking about coexisting with
Pokémon, but I can’t help but wonder if anyone’s<U+0010><U+0001>븀
asked the Pokémon what THEY want.

Some directors shoot footage on
their Rotom Phones, don’t they?

Thanks to safe landing mode,
they can even film up on cliffs!

I think it’d be nice to live in a
tent up on a roof somewhere...

Wild Pokémon should be able
to live freely on our rooftops.

You gotta enjoy whatever comes
at you if you want a carefree life.

That incident caused by Team Flare five years ago
set a lot of things in motion here in Lumiose.

I should buy Berries
for my Pokémon...

People just love our baguettes,
butter, and rustic boule loaves.

Mix oil, vinegar, and mustard,
and you’ve got dressing! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I had some real satisfying wins in
my Z-A Royale matches last night.

Gah. My shortest route goes over a
roof that’s crawling with Pokémon.
Is feeding wild Pokémon bad?

The teacher said we should let wild Pokémon find
food on their own, like in nature.

Riolu uses its aura to
sense what’s around it.

We furisode girls are known for battling with
Audino as our partner Pokémon!

I like to spend my days standing outside wild
zones, watching all the wild Pokémon inside.

Just running the same old
route at my usual pace.

I’d like to try out the Z-A Royale, but my vacation
isn’t long enough for me to climb up the ranks.

I’m gathering Colorful Screws so I can keep
expanding my collection of Canari plush.

By night, I patrol the streets for the Z-A Royale.
By day...I pray the city stays quiet.
Yes! I’m a rich boy!

Physical walls, I can smash. Walls
holding me back in life, though...

On our next test, we’ve gotta spell
every single Pokémon name right!

Well, I know what type
every Pokémon is.
I’d rather learn by battling...

If you want to be like a Trainer you
admire, study up on them!

Don’t sink too many hours into work, or your
partner Pokémon will get lonely!

I vent all my stress in my Z-A Royale matches. My
Pokémon do, too!

People used to be able to take a quiz inside Prism
Tower a few years ago. It was pretty fun...

My thoughts always get muddled
when I try to put them into words.

Maybe I should’ve waited until
it could learn more moves...?

I know traveling won’t change my
life...but I can’t stop doing it!

No one can see our inner selves,
so I make my outer self look great!

You know, Spritzee give
off a wonderful aroma.

How are Pokémon able
to learn moves, anyway?

Pokémon are so smart—they can
understand their Trainer’s orders!

The strongest Trainers are those who can use
Mega Evolution.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I hear the top ranks of the Z-A Royale are filled
with Trainers who Mega Evolve their Pokémon.

Let’s go to Café Gallant and get
ourselves a Gallant Dark Roast!

Didn’t we go
there yesterday?

Well, my vote goes
to Café Triste!
No one can beat my Pinsir!
My Heracross is the strongest!
C’mon, let’s do Paldea next.
I’d really rather go to Galar...

Learning moves of various types means you’ll be
able to handle all sorts of opponents.

I wanna go
see a movie!

We’re not going anywhere
until you two agree...

I wanna go
shopping!

Nouveau Café is sort of
like a self-help group. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I heard that this real strong Trainer called Leon
got completely lost when he visited Lumiose!

I wanna make my Pokémon strong so grown-ups
can’t tell me what to do anymore!

That’s what’s great about Pokémon battles, right?
Even kids like us can win against adults.

I love chatting with old friends at our usual café,
enjoying the same food we always order.

I think things are going good,
but I still feel uneasy somehow...

Huh. I just remembered that huge
blackout we had five years ago.

Nothing says “Z-A Royale life” like rousing yourself
with a hot cup of coffee as you watch the sunrise.

Lumiose is the city
of gourmet cuisine!

Ahh, my phone’s out of battery...
Guess I used it too much today.

Remember to recharge your own
batteries, too, once we’re home!

Going on walks is more fun when
you can name the flowers you see!

I thought working for Nouveau
would be more exciting than this...

Making sweets or treats?
Buy some Berries here! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I want to battle opponents I can beat!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But I can’t go around asking people what
Pokémon they use before I battle them...

Want to win battles even when the type matchup
isn’t in your favor? Then you gotta level up!

What happens in Lumiose stays in Lumiose...so it
doesn’t matter if I lose all my battles here!

We should have a contest to
crown Lumiose’s best café! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I just watch films I like—I never
pay attention to the reviews.

I can’t wait to see that
new film Diantha’s in!

Attack or defend? It depends
on your position on the field.

Don’t you get scared climbing ladders? And being
high up?

Naw, it’s fine if I have my Rotom Phone. Even if I
fall, it’ll catch me!

Battle courts... They’re where Trainers and their
Pokémon should be putting it all on the line!

I’m terrible at battles, but I like
giving commentary on them.

What a narrow alley... Hope I don’t
get ambushed by wild Pokémon.

Wouldn’t it be great if we had a gizmo that works
like a TM, but for human use? We’d be able to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
memorize all sorts of things at the drop of a hat!

You can’t change the nickname of
a Pokémon you got in a trade.

Urk. I’m so sorry for giving a weird
name to the Pokémon I traded you.

Nothing can attack you from
behind if your back’s to the wall.

My backpack contains everything I need for travel.
And my Poké Balls contain my precious partners!

Holovators and ladders are used for similar
purposes, but they’re pretty different!

What a gorgeous kimono. I wonder if it’s a
vintage piece?

This particular furisode is worth about 200
Big Nuggets.

Trubbish is cute, but you gotta be
careful of the toxic gas it belches.

Apparently all the bamboo at the Rust Syndicate
office was planted for their Pangoro to use.
I only listen to electronic music.

I hate that the Z-A Royale only happens at night.
They should do it during the day sometimes so<U+0010><U+0001>븀
kids can join in, too!

Surprise attacks are allowed in the Z-A Royale
since all the participating Trainers agreed to it.

That’s right. It’s important to obey the rules—even
more so to make them in the first place.

I wish I could have a clever
Pokémon do my job for me...

Emma found my lost Patrat when I asked her
for help!
Emma’s super strong, isn’t she?
She wore that cool suit, too!

I can’t help but wonder what was
going on in Lysandre’s head...

Where are all the people
from Team Flare now?

I just want to go to a wild zone and
dodge Pokémon’s attacks! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I wonder if there are any
Pokémon that like coffee... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I fight with my Pokémon over
Berries when I’m hungry... <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Everyone has a different Pokémon
that they think is the strongest.

I’ve battled like a maniac over the
years. Lost every time, but still. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

What does “coexistence”
even mean, really? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I slave away at work during the day, then battle it
out in the Z-A Royale at night...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
When am I supposed to sleep?

I can’t wait to go home
and dote on my Pokémon!

It’s great up on the rooftops, huh?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You’ll sometimes even find rare Pokémon and
huge clusters of Mega Crystals up here.

I love being up high. If only I
could climb Prism Tower...

Yes, people visit cafés for the food.
But mostly, they just want to talk.

I gotta stop moping about that
time I chose the wrong move.

Sure, Pokémon are amazing for being able to
battle. But so are Trainers!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
They need to make split-second calls in high-
stress situations, after all.

When I think about how Pokémon are able to
understand and act on their Trainer’s orders,<U+0010><U+0001>븀
I’m like...wow. Pokémon are amazing!

Should I polish my strong points
or cover my weak points...?

Ooh, that pesky Galarian... Was he
avenging his ancestors or what?

I took a different route today...
and I’m now completely lost.

I just... I just wanted to battle
that Trainer one more time...

Ohmygosh! I forgot to snap a
pic at the café for my socials.

I don’t care about which café is
trending online. I go where I like!
Lumiose City is enormous...

Rule one: no mishaps! Rule two: read the
situation and act accordingly!

One second of carelessness
can lead to a lifetime of regret.

Yesterday was incident-free, but
that doesn’t mean today will be!
Safety first!

Work equipment: checked!
Bag items: double-checked!
Chasing off wild Pokémon is part of our job, too.

There are more wild Pokémon
stealing our electricity lately.

I want to do a job that lets me test my skills
against people from all over the world.

You know what lets you take on the world?
Pokémon battling!

Rooftops are THE place to
spend your breaks, am I right?

There are always the same people sitting at the
same tables at the same café at the same time...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
but I’ve never talked with any of them.

The secret to winning battles?
Just keep trying till you win.

Diantha’s focusing on her
acting career right now.

You should just keep
using strong moves!

No, you should keep
using fast moves!

When the urban redevelopment plan wraps up,
it’ll be tough finding work in construction...

We leave the heavy lifting on-site to Pokémon. It
makes sense, since they’re better at it.

We Canatics need to keep the chat
popping during Canari’s streams!
What are you thinking for this year’s vacation?
Hm... Maybe a Treasure Hunt in Paldea?

My next delivery is to a top-floor
apartment? All those stairs...

When I die, I’d like to be buried in
the same grave as my Pokémon.

I wish I could put my whole
backpack in a Poké Ball, too.

I wonder what I could get for winning the whole
Z-A Royale?

Mega Evolution is so crazy powerful, it could end
up hurting Pokémon...

Siebold left the Elite Four
to polish his culinary skills.

Sometimes I have to make deliveries while
Pokémon are attacking or chasing me...

You have to wear a furisode if you want to work at
Sushi High Roller.

That mayor, outsourcing our urban
development to some foreign firm!

It’s Team Flare’s fault for
causing that huge incident!

I hear Mega Stones and Mega
Crystals are made of similar stuff.

How do I get my Pokémon
to grow up strong?

I owe my life to the
Rust Syndicate...

I hate waking up in the mornings,
and I hate falling asleep at night!

I love pretty much
anything I get to eat!

It’s strange being on a rooftop and looking down
at people below or at Pokémon in the wild zones.

Have you ever taken a relaxing sip of hot coffee,
then spat it out because it’s too hot?

On days off work, it’s nice to bring food over to
your friend or family’s house, then spend the day<U+0010><U+0001>븀
relaxing and chatting together.

I can tell if a Pokémon gets
on well with its Trainer! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Showers seem to be more
popular than baths in Lumiose.

You can’t sweat the small stuff
if you want to live a happy life.

So what if I wear the same outfit
every day? I’m expressing myself.

No one’s ever actually seen a lost Poké Ball
collector picking up people’s Poké Balls...

Being the Champion is cool, but being in the top
rank of the Z-A Royale would be cool too.

It’s wonderful that we can encounter wild
Pokémon right here in the city without having<U+0010><U+0001>븀
to travel far away.

Whatever happened to Professor Sycamore’s
assistants? Dexio and Sina, weren’t they?

Whenever I mess up, I make sure
to send my partner a bouquet...

I just want things to calm down...
I need some rest and relaxation!

When I get tired, I like to go to the
rooftop and just scream out loud!

I came here to catch Pokémon
you can only find in Lumiose!

Faster than yesterday! More than yesterday!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I always try to beat my performance from the day
before.

One of the best battles I ever saw was between
Leon and Raihan in the Galar region.

The joy of living with Pokémon only increases as
the years go by.

I wish Pokémon class
was just about battling.

My bed’s nice and soft, so I let my Pokémon sleep
on it. I get the hard sofa.

A traveling carnival used to come here when I was
a little girl. I adored the carousel—it always felt<U+0010><U+0001>븀
like I was riding a Pokémon!

Standing in the sun gets
me heated up for battle!

I’m picking up fallen
feathers again today.

Do you think a Pokémon
could be mayor someday?

It’s just not possible to see
everything in Lumiose!

Anyone who has a Pokémon is a Trainer, but it’s
not as if they all want to be the very best.

Seeing paw prints left by Pokémon in wet
concrete fills me with joy.

My Pichu may not look like it, but it’s my
bodyguard!

My friend once said: “If I turn into a lousy
grown-up, promise me you’ll punch me!”<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I wonder where he is now...

Won’t all of Lumiose be covered in wild zones at
this rate?

You know Lebanne from the SBC? The one who’s
always following around after Jacinthe?<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Well, I heard she used to be big in some kind of
fighting scene, but I wonder if that’s true...

I only want to eat tasty food. Who
knows how many meals I got left?

I always feel great when
the weather’s nice!

Trainers need to keep switching the best
Pokémon into battle as the situation changes.

The number of wild Pokémon
around the city is soaring.

*sigh* Another day without being
reincarnated as a Pokémon...

I wanna play soccer with the
Pokémon in the wild zones!

I wanna run all around
Lumiose and play tag!

I’d rather play hide-and-seek,
but I don’t think it’d ever end.

I’ve been changing my daily
routines to match my Pokémon’s.

Isn’t it great? You can sleep
whenever you feel tired!
It really makes you feel alive.

When a Pokémon’s type matches the type of the
move it uses, that move gets a power boost!

Still, it comes in handy to teach your Pokémon all
sorts of moves—even if a move’s type doesn’t<U+0010><U+0001>븀
match your Pokémon’s type.

I could chat about that book for
hours! Hope my friends read it too.

I’m gonna spend my entire life answering the
question of how Mega Stones are made!

More and more people are using food delivery
services these days. We’re as busy as anything!

I’ll live my very best life and
become the me I want to be!

When you think about how much time you’ll be
spending with the Pokémon you catch, it makes<U+0010><U+0001>븀
you consider carefully before throwing the ball.

Lumiose is changing real fast. I wonder what it’ll
be like here by the time I’m grown up.

When Banette looked at me, I felt
like I heard it say, “Not this one.”

I felt something following me, so
I turned and...it was a Haunter!

This one time when I was in bed,
I saw a Spinarak on the ceiling.

I don’t collect Pokémon just for the sake of it—it’s
my obsession! I think that’s a certain kind of love.

That’s right... My fixation on Ghost-type Pokémon
is simply love in a different form...

Why do people wonder why I’ve got Simisage as
my partner? I just really developed a liking for it.

Picking a backstreet like this as a meetup spot is
just asking for both parties to get horribly lost.

Think, THINK! What souvenir
can I only get here in Lumiose?

No time for sightseeing—I want to
battle! It’s the Z-A Royale for me!

So as you go out from Centrico
Plaza, it’s Sector 1...then 2...

My bed’s super effective at making
me drowsy. Mornings are tough!

Lumiose is a chic city, sure, but it’s tough living
here. Holding down a job, dealing with rent...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
and don’t even get me started on the people!

I’m glad there’ll be more Pokémon around the
city, but we should first make sure that the needs<U+0010><U+0001>븀
of all the humans who live here are being met.

It seems that sales of Poké Balls and other goods
for Pokémon are booming all over the city.

My dad works for Quasartico, so I’m allowed to
use their battle court too.
Vinnie is teaching me a lot about battling!

I hear a lot of Quasartico’s employees are talented
battlers. It’s probably because the company deals<U+0010><U+0001>븀
in Pokémon goods.

Lots of people are buying
things for Pokémon lately. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

If Pokémon join the workforce,
what’ll happen to human workers?

I wonder why Pokémon
come here to the city?

Everyone wants to become
stronger than their past self!

I found it hard fitting in
when I first moved here.

Thinking is my job. And to
do that well, I need to relax.

If you practice something a lot, it
simply becomes muscle memory!

One day I’m gonna be a big company boss and
have a big building like this one!
Quasartico’s president is so dignified and cool.
What a huge building...

How in the world is the holo-tech
you see in wild zones even made?

We get a lot of Quasartico
employees as customers.

Quasartico recruits Trainers
who show potential in battle.

Hunger is the very best
seasoning for a tasty dinner!

I usually work remote, but I had
to come in for a battle today.

Should I have a bento for lunch?
That’d be the nice, healthy option.

I heard they found Mega Stones when they were
digging for the urban redevelopment plan.

Vinnie may look scary, but he
really dotes on that kid of his.

This urban redevelopment plan
means there’s never a slow day...

People say that the first Pokémon in Kalos to
undergo Mega Evolution was a Lucario.

I wanted to soak in the sights and sounds of
Lumiose my way, so I tossed the guidebook!

Don’t you think the stylists here in Lumiose are
unbelievably good at dyeing hair?

The incident with Team Flare five years ago sent
shock waves through the whole of Kalos.

Running helps me release all the stress I get from
losing battles.

Pokémon living in the city may be able to form
new kinds of relationships with humans.

All day, it’s deliveries to Quasartico
and pickups from Quasartico...

I won’t let myself be outshone
by those Dedenne guards...

We need regulations to manage
the rise in Pokémon numbers.

I wish someone would research
the Pokémon living in the city.

With more Pokémon around, will
there be less room for people?

What’s going to happen
to Prism Tower?

There’s no escaping from wild Pokémon if you
run into them on scaffolding.

Nuh-uh! If you have a Rotom Phone, you can just
jump off like “look out belooow!”

Racine Construction’s scaffolding is good and
sturdy, but you still shouldn’t play around on it.

You meet many good people in
life, but lots of bad ones too.

Nothing better than a fresh-baked
baguette with heaps of butter!

Huh?! You can’t poison a
Poison-type Pokémon?
Valerie is from a far-off region called Johto.

A wild Pokémon ran off with my packages in one
of the back alleys near here.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
I chased after it and got them back, but I couldn’t
have done it without my partner Pokémon.

In the Z-A Royale, I’d recommend sneaking up on
your opponents and their Pokémon, then catching<U+0010><U+0001>븀
them off guard with a surprise attack!

I’ll help you
however I can!

Today’s the day I find my
dream partner Pokémon!

It’s love that brings people and
Pokémon together, not Poké Balls.

I feel like I was destined to meet
all the Pokémon I’ve caught. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

You gotta throw lots of Poké Balls
to earn a Pokémon’s respect!

Pokémon and their
Trainers are like family.

I heard that some people leave Potions lying
around to help injured Pokémon.

My luggage was stolen right after I arrived in
Lumiose...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Luckily, it was just a prank and I was able to get
all my stuff back.

Your Houndoom is an impressive specimen—it’s
just as fearsome as it is adorable!

Your Gabite is similarly delightful. You don’t see
that species too often, so I approve of the choice.

Rumor has it a darkly colored
Pokémon appears at night.

Oh yes—it’s been seen with
some shady-looking man, right?

There’s all kinds of Pokémon around the world.
They use all sorts of moves, battle in different<U+0010><U+0001>븀
ways, and all have their own way of living!

Go where you want,
die where you must.

Tonight I’m getting a ticket
in the Z-A Royale for sure!

The very best way to start your day is with the
aroma of fresh bread and coffee!

I bet we’ll soon see a restaurant that caters only
to Pokémon.

My Delibird keeps dropping
Berries all over the place...

Mega Crystals showed up after
urban redevelopment started.

The wild zones have apparently drawn even more
tourists to come visit Lumiose.

Bridges are the best spots to pick when meeting
up with friends in Lumiose. The area around<U+0010><U+0001>븀
Prism Tower is way too big to find anyone.

Corbeau from the Rust
Syndicate is so cool!

Ivor from the Fist of Justice
is super-duper strong!

No two days are the same, even if
they do feel repetitive sometimes.

I’m so good at sleeping, I can
do it with my eyes closed.

I can’t tell you how helpful it is that Pokémon
carry building materials up the scaffolding for us.

A city as big as Lumiose is going
to have its fair share of drifters.

I’m a peerless Pokémon Trainer! Literally, in fact!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
No one takes me up on my battle challenges...

Training your Pokémon isn’t the same as loving
them. You need to do other things together, too.

I love my Pokémon! They come and rub their fur
against me when I’m feeling sad.

I heard that some of the Trainers competing in the
Z-A Royale are gaining tons of fans lately.

I’m not a battler myself, but I like hearing about
strong Trainers and their Pokémon.

I never think about the past or future. Instead, I
treasure each moment of the present.

Folks in Lumiose spend more time chatting after
battles than they do actually battling.

If you want to make your Pokémon strong, you
yourself must first be strong.

No point having a huge place to
yourself. A cozy room is just fine.

Even Pokémon of the same species all have
different strengths.

Pokémon raised by people will grow stronger than
wild Pokémon, you know.

Wrinkles around the eyes are proof
you’ve spent a lifetime laughing.

Even if I don’t know what a move
does, I teach it to my Pokémon.

The clerk at the Stone Emporium
has a weird laugh—like “Po-ho-ho!”

Pokémon resent their Trainers if
they’re knocked out often in battle.

Do you have your Pokémon hold items in battle?
I’d recommend a Quick Claw, myself.

You know Sushi High Roller? Well, I heard the
owner’s parents also run a sushi restaurant.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
I wonder what region they’re from...

I’m so grateful to my Pokémon for
shaking up my monotonous life.

Humans can’t beat Pokémon in a
fight, no matter how hard they try.

I remember playing pétanque
in the plaza when I was little.

Pokémon can eat Berries on their
own, but they can’t use Potions.

How about we join the Z-A Royale together? If we
watch each other’s backs, we’ll have a leg up over<U+0010><U+0001>븀
all the other Trainers!

I don’t hate the idea, but it’d reduce our mobility
a fair amount.

The world is vast! Boundless, even! There must be
so many Pokémon out there no one’s ever seen!

I feel like Pokémon get me. Even
if I’m just imagining it, it’s nice.

But still the only thing I can do is
sing—sing my humble song. ♪

Maybe I can’t cheer someone on
just with the tunes I play. ♪

Piers writes great
music, doesn’t he?

I don’t know what this thing is, but when I look at
it, it’s like my heart kinda squeezes.

I think it’s called an obelisk? It’s like a monument
for people to remember something.

I say Pokémon count as family. We make so many
memories together across the course of our lives.
My first memory is of Meowstic levitating me.

Life is wonderful when Pokémon are around to
make you laugh every day.

Feel free to browse our menu,
even just out of curiosity.

During my travels in Paldea, I saw sculptures by
an artist named Brassius. They were pretty good!

The Lumiose Museum should put some of them
into a special exhibition! I’d love to see them.

The water in Kalos is natural spring water—it’s
bursting with minerals.

Different regions have different water, huh? Still,
they’re all called Fresh Water when bottled.

Keeping quiet won’t do you any
favors in life. Just talk, talk, talk!

Am I still a courier even when
I’m not out making deliveries?

I’ve been battling for 50 years...
These old bones are tired of it.

You should save up your Mega Power so you can
use Plus Moves in battle.

I didn’t know that the Pokémon
Center staff works in shifts!

Cooking isn’t important for me—
I just want to eat food I like.

I bet I could get in about a hundred steps with
one lap around Magenta Plaza.

The Ember Roast they serve at
Nouveau Café is sooo good!

I feel so relaxed when I have a
